newsitem.title: USA: Moody's affirms H&R Block Inc units.
newsitem.headline: Moody's affirms H&R Block Inc units.

text.p: NEW YORK, July 17 - Moody's Investors Service confirmed the ratings of Block Financial Corporation and H&R Block Canada, Inc. for commercial paper at Prime-1.
The commercial paper of both companies is guaranteed by their parent, H&R Block Inc (HNB), the largest tax preparation concern in the US.
The ratings were placed on review on April 18, 1997, following HNB's announcement that it would acquire Option One Mortgage Corporation for $200 million.

The confirmation reflects Moody's expectation that, although HNB's acquisition of Option One increased its leverage, the company will maintain sufficient financial flexibility in managing its traditional business and in implementing its diversification strategy.

HNB's financial flexibility stems from the strong and predictable earnings of its tax preparation business. Although the earnings of Option One are subject to institutional demand for its sub-prime mortgage assets, Option One's credit exposure to the underlying assets should remain comparatively moderate.
Moody's added that HNB's efforts to originate residential mortgages from its tax preparation offices should benefit from Option One's expertise.
The Company's aim to divest its CompuServe investment remains unresolved, but Moody's concludes that, under a number of likely scenarios, this action should not be a rating issue.
Block Financial Corporation -- Prime-1 rating of the company for commercial paper.
H&R Block Canada Inc. -- Prime-1 rating of the company for commercial paper.
H&R Block headquarters is in Kansas City, Missouri. At April 30, 1997, its assets totaled $1.9 billion.
